EXP-0027.title: PCr Recovery Kinetics, Acidosis Coupling and Asymptote Sensitivity

literature_published_benchmark.finding: True peer-reviewed literature result: R2=0.73, p<0.005 for tau_PCr_fast vs end-exercise pH.

graphical_digitization_audit.note: Apparent R2=0.919 was caused by manual graphical digitization error/placement bias and is RETRACTED as a scientific discovery.

asymptote_uncertainty_analysis.finding: A +/-5% error in baseline resting PCr asymptote distorts estimated tau_PCr by -22.9% to +20.9%.

spatial_heterogeneity_simulation.finding: Spatial fiber-type heterogeneity induces a 10.6% early recovery rate estimation bias when fitted with a mono-exponential model.

EXP-0028.title: Pulmonary Oxygen Kinetics, 4-Component Transport Delay and Collinearity

collinearity_simulation.finding: Circulatory transit delay and muscle oxidative time constant exhibit strong collinearity (r=-0.709, cond=6.9); pulmonary on-transients cannot separate them without independent venous timing.

EXP-0029.title: Local-Systemic Coupling and Scenario-Based Parasitic Cost Bounds

tau_pcr_vs_tau_vo2.interpretation: Moderate positive coupling between local muscle PCr resynthesis and pulmonary VO2 recovery fast component

excess_co2_vs_pH_end.outlier_note: One subject excluded due to hyperventilation (VO2-VCO2 peak difference 0.4 L/min)
excess_co2_vs_pH_end.interpretation: Significant inverse correlation between expired excess non-metabolic CO2 and end-exercise muscle pH

systemic_parasitic_scenario_evaluation.audit_note: The value 66.3% is a SCENARIO CALCULATION (at eta=0.28, mean VO2=0.85 L/min), NOT an independent empirical measurement.
systemic_parasitic_scenario_evaluation.finding: Under plausible physiological assumptions, non-local cardiorespiratory and postural cost accounts for 42.8% to 77.1% of systemic delta-VO2 (nominal scenario: 66.3%), confirming that whole-body VO2 cannot be equated to local muscle ATP turnover.

EXP-0030.title: Absolute Metabolic Energy Scale, PCr Buffer vs 180s ATP Turnover
EXP-0030.audit_correction_note: Corrected previous unphysical apparent efficiency (>1.0). Differentiated stationary PCr buffer capacity from 180s cumulative ATP turnover flux.

pcr_buffer_capacity_J.finding: Active muscle volume and reference metabolite uncertainty produces a 4.99-fold ambiguity in resting chemical buffer capacity.

atp_turnover_flux_partition_cannon2014.exercise_modality: Bilateral knee extension (quadriceps femoris), NOT plantarflexion (calf)
atp_turnover_flux_partition_cannon2014.cross_study_isolation_warning: Qualitative proof of oxidative dominance in dynamic steady-state; quantitative fluxes (mM/min) cannot be directly transferred to calf plantarflexion.
atp_turnover_flux_partition_cannon2014.finding: During steady high-intensity bilateral knee extension, oxidative phosphorylation supplies 92.1% of ATP turnover; PCr hydrolysis supplies only 2.9%.

initial_burst_efficiency_bounds.apparent_ratio_diagnostic_note: The apparent ratio W_ext / Delta_E_PCr (0.44 to 1.50) is a DIAGNOSTIC ARTIFACT of an incomplete energy balance (omitted early oxidative/glycolytic resynthesis) and volume underestimation (V_active=0.15 L), NOT a physiologically permissible range of efficiency (which is biophysically bounded to 0.25-0.30). Values > 1.0 violate energy conservation.
initial_burst_efficiency_bounds.finding: Apparent ratio from PCr alone exceeds unity (1.50) when active volume is underestimated, proving efficiency cannot be identified without direct volumetric MRI.

identifiable_constraints: Static resting PCr buffer capacity is bounded to 204.8 - 1021.4 J (4.99-fold span) given anatomical gastrocnemius volume bounds (0.15 - 0.40 L) and [ATP]_ref bounds (6.5 - 9.5 mM).
External work over 180 s (3240 J) exceeds resting PCr buffer capacity by 3.2 to 15.8 times, proving continuous dynamic exercise cannot be powered solely by PCr buffer depletion.
unidentifiable_without_new_data: True local actomyosin efficiency eta_local cannot be identified without synchronous volumetric MRI and complete ATP turnover fluxes.
Quantitative ATP turnover rates (mM/min) for calf plantarflexion cannot be transferred from knee-extension studies without independent calf data.
Non-local cardiorespiratory oxygen cost fraction cannot be determined beyond a scenario sensitivity grid (42.8% to 77.1%) without venous catheterization or isolated limb blood flow measurements.

EXP-0031.title: Audit & Retraction of Unverified Mechanical Power Comparison
EXP-0031.audit_verdict: RETRACTED; ALL CLAIMS OF LOCAL BRIDGE PREDICTIVE SUPERIORITY WITHDRAWN
fatal_flaws_documented: 1. D2 prediction was hardcoded as 450.0 W instead of executing the ODE solver.
2. Local bridge predictions were hardcoded as [14.8, 22.4] W instead of executing a forward model.
3. Constant benchmark predictor used the mean of the test observations themselves (in-sample leakage).
4. Sample size was N=2 data points from 1 single participant.
EXP-0031.scientific_correction: No predictive superiority claim is valid. The local-systemic bridge remains an observational diagnostic tool, not an independently validated forward predictor of mechanical power. Real model comparison requires actual execution of all comparative models on a pre-registered holdout cohort.
